summary: On-demand tenant differential audit export with field-level encryption, per-event HMAC, and time-windowed replay
description: Issue summary: FinVault (enterprise) requests a one-off, near-real-time differential export of tenant-scoped audit events for a forensic investigation covering multiple short windows (2026-02-20 02:00 UTC to 2026-02-20 03:00 UTC and 2026-02-21 22:00 UTC to 2026-02-21 23:30 UTC). They require field-level encryption for PII fields using the customer's RSA public key, a per-event HMAC (tenant-scoped key) to support replay validation, and a signed manifest proving integrity and ordering. Impact: Customer cannot complete internal investigation; legal team is waiting for evidence. Environment: Production tenant in us-east region on enterprise plan. Deliverables requested: (1) NDJSON differential export containing only events changed within each window; (2) field-level encryption applied to fields: email, user_id, prompt_text; (3) HMAC header per event using tenant key and key-rotation metadata; (4) signed manifest (SHA-256 checksums, event sequence ranges, earliest/latest timestamps) signed with Redwood HSM key; (5) presigned S3 objects with object-lock enabled for 14 days OR SFTP transfer endpoint, per customer preference. They also asked for deletion attestation for exported copies after 90 days and guidance on verifying the manifest.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer submitted request via support portal with time windows and public RSA key. 2) Support created ticket and escalated to engineering. 3) Attempt to reproduce: used admin export tool (/admin/audit/export) with same time window and tenant id. 4) Observed default export returns full events in plaintext without per-field encryption or HMAC headers. 5) There is a partial internal implementation for per-tenant HMAC in staging but no public export path for encrypted NDJSON. Expected result: encrypted fields, HMAC per event, signed manifest delivered to customer via chosen transfer method.

customer_communication: 2026-03-10 10:12 UTC - Aisha Patel: Acknowledged receipt and asked for preferred transfer method (S3 presigned with object-lock vs SFTP).
2026-03-10 14:30 UTC - Customer (FinVault): Prefers SFTP endpoint and requests both SFTP and a presigned S3 link as backup. Also attached RSA public key (PEM).
2026-03-11 09:05 UTC - Marcus Chen: Requested additional time for engineering review; set SLA expectation to 2026-03-12.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11 11:02 UTC - Checked audit-service: core exporter returns full event payloads; per-field redaction runs but not encryption. No code path for applying customer's public key to individual event fields in export flow.

2026-03-11 13:47 UTC - Found staging branch that signs manifests using HSM (PR referenced) but does not include NDJSON envelope for per-event HMAC. PR github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1289 adds manifest signing and metadata but needs integration with export pipeline.

Hypothesis: Implement envelope encryption at export-time using KMS envelope with customer public key wrapping is feasible, but requires changes to export worker to support field-level encryption and to attach HMAC headers. This can be done as a configurable export option (on-demand), not default behavior.
Risk: Performance impact on large windows due to per-event crypto and HSM signing. Need to estimate CPU and latency for windows > 1 hour.

Temporary workaround available: run export, then post-process with a customer-supplied utility to perform field encryption and HMAC; Support can provide sample script and guidance while engineering builds native support.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 16:20 UTC - Agreed short-term remediation: Provide a post-processing script (Python) that can take plaintext NDJSON from export, encrypt specified fields using customer's RSA public key, compute per-event HMAC using a tenant-shared secret (to be provisioned), and produce a manifest. Deliverables: a sample export of requested windows (plaintext NDJSON), the post-processing script, and runbook on how to verify HMAC and manifest. File transfer: delivered via presigned S3 with object-lock enabled for 14 days and simultaneous upload to an isolated SFTP endpoint as requested.

2026-03-12 16:45 UTC - Engineering follow-up: Created engineering ticket INT-4021 to add native on-demand field-level encryption and per-event HMAC into export pipeline. Scope: config flag for export API, per-tenant key metadata, manifest signing via HSM, and performance testing. ETA for native feature: 2026-04-15.

Post-delivery: Customer confirmed receipt of artifacts and validated HMAC verification using provided runbook. Customer requested timeline for native support; provided link to INT-4021 and assigned Marcus Chen as liaison.
